comparison.objective: Selectively remove one chip from an open packet while retaining the other chips.
comparison.physical_skill: Confined grasping and extraction from a movable container; optional stabilization.
comparison.success_condition: One chip rests on a plate, the other two remain contained, the packet stays stable, and hands clear.
comparison.reason: The candidate commissions a captive-screw-locked rotary damper and evaluates repeated dynamic stops. Selective retrieval and retention test a different ability; shared grasping is only generic.
